newsitem.title: HONG KONG: S&P affirms ratings on Sampoerna.
newsitem.headline: S&P affirms ratings on Sampoerna.

text.p: Standard & Poors said on Monday it had affirmed its BBB-plus local currency corporate credit rating on Indonesian conglomerate PT Hanjaya Mandala Sampoerna.
It also affirmed its BBB foreign currency rating on the US$200 million note issue of Sampoerna's wholly-owned subsidiary Sampoerna International Finance BV.
The rating outlook is stable, S&P said in a release issued in Hong Kong.
In October, S&P said it may cut the ratings of Sampoerna and its unit after the company announced it would invest in shares of Indonesian motor vehicle manufacturer PT Astra International .
The affirmation follows conclusion of Sampoerna's involvement in the investment and its commitment to conservatively finance major future investment activities within the Sampoerna group, S&P said.
It said the ratings reflect the strong profitability of Sampoerna's core cigarette manufacturing and distribution business.
